claims.claim: SRP is essentially all available to algae, but much high-molecular-weight dissolved P goes unused (Boström, Persson & Broberg 1988, abstract)
claims.note: Full text not read; the abstract was not read in this pass either (the Springer page is a paywall page to scripts; the attempt to read the abstract through Semantic Scholar was refused by the session's permission system). The research note catchment_P_loads.md quotes the abstract: 'Large fractions of dissolved P go unused and are mainly in the high molecular weight fraction', and says immediately available P is often less than DRP at low concentrations (< 10 µg DRP/L). If that is right, 'SRP is essentially all available' needs that qualification at low SRP.
